001package org.clafer.choco.constraint.propagator;
002
003import java.util.Arrays;
004import org.chocosolver.solver.constraints.Propagator;
005import org.chocosolver.solver.constraints.PropagatorPriority;
006import org.chocosolver.solver.exception.ContradictionException;
007import org.chocosolver.solver.variables.SetVar;
008import org.chocosolver.util.ESat;
009
010/**
011 *
012 * @author jimmy
013 */
014public class PropReflexive extends Propagator<SetVar> {
015
016    private static final long serialVersionUID = 1L;
017
018    public PropReflexive(SetVar[] relation) {
019        super(relation, PropagatorPriority.UNARY, false);
020    }
021
022    @Override
023    public void propagate(int evtmask) throws ContradictionException {
024        for (int i = 0; i < vars.length; i++) {
025            vars[i].force(i, this);
026        }
027        setPassive();
028    }
029
030    @Override
031    public ESat isEntailed() {
032        boolean allUbContains = true;
033        for (int i = 0; i < vars.length; i++) {
034            SetVar var = vars[i];
035            if (!var.getUB().contains(i)) {
036                return ESat.FALSE;
037            }
038            allUbContains &= var.getLB().contains(i);
039        }
040        return allUbContains ? ESat.TRUE : ESat.UNDEFINED;
041    }
042
043    @Override
044    public String toString() {
045        return "reflexive(" + Arrays.toString(vars) + ")";
046    }
047}
